desc: Construct the graph with edges $i \to P_i$ and $i \to Q_i$ for all $i$, and a reverse graph for reachability analysis.
Perform a BFS starting from $X$ in the reverse graph to identify all nodes $v$ that can reach $X$ (set $S_{reach}$).
Identify the set of initially non-empty boxes (where $A_i + B_i > 0$).
Perform a BFS/DFS starting from the initially non-empty boxes in the original graph to find all nodes that will receive balls (set $S_{active}$).
Verify if every node in $S_{active}$ is also in $S_{reach}$. If not, print -1.
If the verification passes, print the size of $S_{active}$.
Implement the solution in Python, reading inputs, building the forward and reverse graphs, performing the two BFS traversals, checking the subset condition, and printing the result.
Run the code against Sample 1, 2, 3, and 4 to verify correctness.
Test with edge cases (e.g., N=2, all empty, all full, cycles).
Confirm time complexity is O(N) given constraints.
